verdicts.reason: Both are badly broken the same way. The wind-turbine icon, which was the hero image, is shrunk to a tiny icon and lined up in a bottom row with the cropped coloured triangles, which now read as stray fragments. The headline is much too large and crowds the top, the diagonal lines float at random, and the bottom row sits jammed against the lower edge. A keeps the text and bottom row on a centred axis, which roughly matches the original's symmetry. B shifts the whole group left, leaving dead space on the right, and its diagonal line runs right up to the end of 'SUMMIT'.
